rss: Earnings limit of up to £140K for first-time buyers loan scheme
title: New Homes for First-Time Buyers!
story: A new plan helps people buy their first homes. They can borrow money if their earnings are not too high.
storyBig: The 'First Nest' program helps first-time home buyers by offering loans for new treehouses. The program supports those with earnings below a certain cap, making homeownership more accessible.
think: Why do you think helping people buy their first homes is important?
bull: More houses could be built for families.
bear: Not everyone may qualify for help.

rss: Lights will stay on this winter, grid operator says after concerns
title: Power Stays On This Winter!
story: The people who manage electricity say everyone will have power this winter. No need to worry about lights going out!
storyBig: The SparkGrid company reassures the public that there will be a steady electricity supply this winter, despite earlier concerns about energy shortages.
think: Why is it important to have electricity during winter?
bull: We can keep warm and cozy all winter long.
bear: Some areas might still face small power cuts.
